title: Willie Paggio and the jitney dance on Burgundy
summary: He played about a year with Paggio at an upstairs dance, with Willie Meenbart on piano and trombonists.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition

blocks.x: It's hard for you. Now, if you have your list there, any other jobs then after those that you mentioned, Bob Lyons and the, is it Darmul Dupass or somebody that you played for at? Right. Right. And who some of your later bands were in the recent years?

Well, I played with Willie Paggio. We played up on, at Burgundy and Canelo, there was a jet and dance upstairs. And I played up there with Willie Paggio for about a year. But before that we played as the Charles and Padres for about six months. Was that another? Another Jitney dance.
Jitney dance. And Willie Meenbart was playing piano. Oh yes.
Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. And Willie Meenbart was playing piano.
Oh yes. Ellie Biggaard was playing trombone. Mm-hmm. Yang Johnson was playing trombone.
When did Yang die about, do you know? I never knew him or his brother.
Did he live longer than Buddy Johnson? Oh yeah. Yeah.
Buddy was dead a good while before him.
Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
with Willie Paggio. Who did you go with? Do you remember?
